notes.title: 🌟 v0.9.986 Major Optimization Patch Notes 🌟
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h3][h3][b]This week's update delivers numerous optimizations and fixes, aiming to significantly enhance your gameplay experience.[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]1️⃣ Rune System Overhaul[/b][/h3][p]We acknowledged that the inability to change runes within dungeons has been a persistent pain point. While this mechanic added strategic depth, it excessively restricted real-time tactical choices during exploration. Key changes:[/p][list][*][p][b]All runes now have a maximum level cap of 3.[/b] Most runes retain their original max stat values at Lv.3 (minor adjustments applied to specific runes).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Runes can now be freely swapped in dungeons.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Craftsman event no longer offer rune-changing services.[/b] Future updates may introduce new services like [i]rune enchantment transfer[/i].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]2️⃣ Dungeon Content Adjustment[/b][/h3][p]Post-launch data showed players engaging in repeated [i]Elemental Surge[/i] challenges for higher rankings. However, excessive combat density in late-game dungeons caused player fatigue. This rebalance optimizes pacing during competitive play.[/p][list][*][p][b]Reduced Mystic Portal frequency in Tier 2/3 dungeons.[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]The number of ​[b]Mystic Portals[/b]​ per Tier is now ​[b]fixed[/b]​ and ​[b]no longer randomized[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]3️⃣ National Flag Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed critical bug preventing correct flag display[/b] for Korean players on challenge leaderboards. [i]We sincerely apologize to our Korean players for this oversight.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added manual flag selection[/b] in character profile pages (accessed via top-left avatar icon). Use this feature if automatic country detection fails.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]4️⃣ Other Key Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Corrected erroneous [b]Soul Reforge attempt counts[/b] on leaderboards ([i]actual scoring calculations were unaffected[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Merchants in dungeons now [b]automatically open shop interfaces[/b] after initial game completion, streamlining card trading.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v0.9.92 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Hello everyone! Game updates and optimizations are progressing as planned.

Today's updates:[/h3][/b]

1️⃣ Card Fusion: Removed card level caps in Tier 1 & 2 dungeons.

2️⃣ Card Fusion: Added new feature - Combine three 5★ cards to create a new 5★ card (no Elemental Essence cost).

3️⃣ Card Album: New rarity filter added.

4️⃣ Optimized performance on certain PCs for smoother gameplay.

5️⃣ Added warning popup for save data errors. Players can now choose to create new save or re-sync Steam Cloud data.

notes.title: v0.9.80 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Hello everyone! A new week, new updates!

Today's Patch Notes:[/h3][/b]

1️⃣ Keyboard Input – Now live as requested!
- Close most UIs with `Esc`
- Navigate dungeon maps with `↑`/`↓`
- Start battles with `Enter`/`Space` or flee with `Esc`

2️⃣ Cataclysm Mode
- Increased drop rates for Crystals & Rawstone!

3️⃣ Dungeon Adjustments
- Reduced Soulforge costs in Tier 2/3 Dungeons

4️⃣ Card Balancing
- Midnight Spellweaver: Slight nerf (was clearly OP)
- Luminary Foreseer & Thornheart Queen: Buffed

5️⃣ Rune Caps
- 5 Elemental Core Runes + 2 Prismatic Runes now max at Lv.4

6️⃣ Bug Fixes
- Fixed abnormal stacking effects for certain runes

7️⃣ Localization
- Improved Japanese translations (thanks @N on Discord!)

notes.title: v0.9.79 更新日誌
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Hello 大家好。
收到不少玩家朋友反馈卡牌文本字体太小问题，今天的更新中放大了卡面文本字体。

然后也对游戏数值进行了调整。具体如下：[/h3][/b]

1️⃣ 以下部分精英特性词条，在高等级部分，持续时间从永久改为了99回合：
带电、瘟疫、恐惧、驱散光环、净化光环

2️⃣ 精英特性词条：强命，复活后的恢复生命值减少

3️⃣ 目前发现中毒流派的强度尚未达到预期，因此对以下几个中毒相关符文进行了增强：
腐蚀：触发后效果改为了只削弱对方攻击力
侵害：改为了施加2次弱化后触发效果
腐败神恩赐：触发持续恢复效果的回合数+1，恢复量+1
腐败神愤怒：毒爆值+1

4️⃣ 以下3张生物卡，永久禁回复效果改为了攻击后禁回复：

5️⃣ 适当增加幸运金币掉落

[b]另外，近日收到少数玩家反馈游戏无法正常存档的问题。
这应该是电脑系统权限不足（如访客登录），或是防火墙拦截导致。如果有遇到这种状况的玩家，可以尝试检查上述2方面，应该可以解决。
如果还不能解决，欢迎加入官方社群，单独与开发者进行联系。
谢谢大家！[/b]

notes.title: v0.9.78 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone! We've been working hard to bring you new optimizations and fixes.

Update details:[/h3]

1️⃣ Fixed character combat animations getting stuck

2️⃣ Fixed game freezing when opening card packs

3️⃣ Fixed "Skip Battle" toggle not being saved

4️⃣ Fixed incorrect values for runes "Voodoo God's Gift" and "Voodoo God's Wrath" after final enchantment level. Both should now correctly trigger effects after applying 4 Poison debuffs.

5️⃣ Added hover tooltips for card pack selection - now you can see detailed descriptions

6️⃣ Expanded the Scavenger's shop - added 2 more item slots

7️⃣ Frog Merchant's trade network expanded - increased currency amounts at each dungeon tier

8️⃣ Adjusted enemy HP in late Tier 3 dungeons and portal challenge areas
